title: StarlessEVENTS
description: A fun scripted Minecraft SMP with custom items, Tons of new adventures, and you players get to help with the script! (Voice Chat not required)
body: This is a fun **SCIPTED** Minecraft SMP with tons of custom items and adventures! This Minecraft SMP does not require voicechat BUT!, You can use it if you want to. This is the StarlessSMP and you can join with the IP.
